title: Announcing 30+ new programs across Coursera and Udemy to help learners build AI and human skills
summary: Today, on the sidelines of our first Coursera + Udemy Partner & Instructor Forum in Madrid, we announced more than 30 new programs and several
body_markdown:
Today, on the sidelines of our first Coursera + Udemy Partner & Instructor Forum in Madrid, we announced more than 30 new programs and several exciting platform updates — all designed to help learners and creators better navigate the changing skills landscape. Held in partnership with Real Madrid at their Bernabéu Stadium, we brought together our top university partners, industry educators, and instructors from around the world to discuss emerging trends, best practices, and new innovations.


Our recent[2026 Global Skills Report](https://blog.coursera.org/global-skills-report-2026/) introduces the industry’s first AI-Human Skills Synergy Index, underscoring that the workforce of the future needs AI fluency and human judgment together — not one at the expense of the other. While[AI deployment is outpacing talent readiness by 2x](https://www.deloitte.com/us/en/what-we-do/capabilities/applied-artificial-intelligence/content/state-of-ai-in-the-enterprise.html) , bridging this gap will take deliberate investment in skills to determine the winners and losers in the AI era.


We’re proud to work with 400 university and industry partners on Coursera and more than 95,000 Udemy instructors who are responding to rapidly changing skills with timely, relevant learning experiences.


**New content on Coursera to bridge AI and human skills** **** Developed by leading university and industry partners with unparalleled expertise, many of these programs blend AI fluency with human judgment rather than teaching them separately, enabling learners to build durable skills they can quickly apply at work. Programs launching today are:


- **Core AI skill-building**


- [Agentic AI with Andrew Ng](https://www.coursera.org/learn/dlai-agentic-ai) from DeepLearning.AI
- [Generative Artificial Intelligence Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/generative-artificial-intelligence) from University of Colorado Boulder


- **GenAI applied on the job**


- [Communicate Your Ideas with Impact: Using Adobe Express and AI Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/communicate-ideas-with-impact-using-adobe-express-and-ai) from Adobe
- **[HBR Guide to Generative AI for Managers Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/generative-ai-for-managers)** from Harvard Business Review
- [Generative AI for Educators: AI Literacy and Prompting Skills](https://www.coursera.org/learn/mqfoa-generative-ai-literacy-and-prompting-skills-for-educators) from Macquarie University
- [AI for Language Teachers: Culturally Responsive Design](https://www.coursera.org/learn/ai-for-language-teachers-mqfoa) from Macquarie
- [AI-Powered Financial Research with Perplexity Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/ai-powered-financial-research-with-perplexity) from Perplexity
- [Secondary Market Research and Analysis with Perplexity Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/secondary-market-research-analyst) from Perplexity


- **Business Strategy and Leadership**


- [Present Like a Leader: Adobe Express Executive Communication Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/present-like-a-leader-adobe-express-executive-communication) **** from Adobe
- **[Introduction to Power and Influence Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/introduction-to-power-and-influence)** from Harvard Business School Online
- [Leadership and Talent Development in Football Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/leadership-and-talent-development-in-football) from Real Madrid Graduate School – Universidad Europea
- [Product Marketing & Go-to-Market Strategy Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/product-marketing-and-go-to-market-strategy) **** from Stanford Online
- [From Product Strategy to Product Leadership Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/from-product-strategy-to-product-leadership) from Stanford Online


- **Law, ethics & governance**


- **[Foundations of American Law Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/foundations-of-american-law)** from University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
- [Intellectual Property Law and Emerging Technologies Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/intellectual-property-law-and-emerging-technologies) from University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
- [AI Governance and Compliance in Law Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/ai-governance-and-compliance-in-law) from University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
- [Ethics and Compliance Law for Business Professionals Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/ethics-compliance-law-business-professionals) from University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign


- **Foundational & professional skills**


- [The Science of Learning: How Learning Works](https://www.coursera.org/learn/the-science-of-learning-how-learning-works-mqfoa) from Macquarie University
- [Blockchain for Business](https://www.coursera.org/learn/blockchain-for-business) from Macquarie University
- [Blockchains and Cryptocurrencies Fundamentals](https://www.coursera.org/learn/blockchains-and-cryptocurrencies-fundamentals) from Macquarie University
- [Introducción interdisciplinar a la sostenibilidad urbana](https://www.coursera.org/learn/introduccion-interdisciplinar-a-la-sostenibilidad-urbana) from Universitat Politècnica de València
- [Formulación y nomenclatura de compuestos químicos](https://www.coursera.org/learn/formulacion-y-nomenclatura-de-compuestos-quimicos) from Universitat Politècnica de València
- [Honors AI & AI Agents for High School Students Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/honors-ai) from Vanderbilt University


**New content from Udemy instructors to develop practical AI skills** **** These new courses on Udemy come directly from experts using AI in their work today, sharing the real-world workflows and human judgment skills that learners need to use AI effectively at work.


- [Claude Cowork – The Practical Guide](https://www.udemy.com/course/claude-cowork-the-practical-guide/) from Academind with Maximillian Schwarzmuller
- [Adaptive Decision Making: Think Fast and Act Smarter](https://www.udemy.com/course/adaptive-decision-making/) from CRFT Productions
- [Leading Through Permanent Uncertainty](https://www.udemy.com/course/leading-through-permanent-uncertainty/) from Deborah Grayson Riegel
- [Decision Making with Problem Solving & Critical Thinking](https://www.udemy.com/course/decision-making-with-problem-solving-critical-thinking/) from Diogo Alves de Resende
- [AI Governance: A Complete Guide for Professionals](https://www.udemy.com/course/ai-governance-a-complete-masterclass/) from Georgi Smarts
- [Agentic Coding with GitHub Copilot: Skills, Agents and MCP](https://www.udemy.com/course/agentic-coding-with-github-copilot-skills-agents-and-mcp/) from Mehmet Ozkaya
- [Get Better at Prompting and Reviewing AI Responses](https://www.udemy.com/course/get-better-at-prompting/) from Nicolle Merrill
- [AI Safety, AI Security, and Responsible AI at Work](https://www.udemy.com/course/ai-safety-ai-security-at-work-course/) from Steve Ballinger, MBA
- [AI Agents for Non-Coders](https://www.udemy.com/course/ai-agents-for-non-coders/) from Video School
- [AI for Product Management & Innovation](https://www.udemy.com/course/ai-for-product-management-innovation/) from Vipesh Singla


These are exactly the durable, foundational skills learners need most right now: the ability to reason carefully, understand data, communicate clearly, and work confidently with AI.


**Product updates designed to empower creators to deliver engaging learning experiences** **** With more than 300 million registered learners across Coursera and Udemy, we’re continuing to evolve the platform experience alongside our content. Our latest updates give creators new ways to connect with learners, showcase their expertise, and use AI to build engaging learning experiences:


- **Redesigned Instructor Profiles on Udemy** : Redesigned profiles give learners a clearer view of an instructor’s expertise, offerings, and community before they join. The new experience also gives instructors more ways to showcase their expertise and manage their profile and content directly.


- **Udemy Communities** : Instructors want a way to stay connected to learners after a course ends, and learners need a place to continue learning together. Udemy Communities now gives instructors a paid, instructor-led community space for discussions, live activities, and more.[Seventeen communities are live](https://www.udemy.com/communities/) **,** with eight more coming soon.


- **AI-Assisted Dialogue and Role Play authoring on Coursera** : Building a realistic practice scenario using an AI persona and a fair grading rubric used to take course authors several hours. Now, creators can generate a full draft in minutes, making it faster to build interactive learning experiences and easier to update them as skills and subject matter evolve. Currently available to all content partners and Enterprise customers.


In a world that is changing so rapidly, learners and customers are constantly looking to develop new skills to achieve their goals. Together with our partners and instructors, we’re making it easier for everyone to be better prepared for the future.
